verdict.rationale: Brex's own Global page documents paying reimbursements to and from local bank accounts to avoid intercompany transactions, and Brex documents automated reimbursement filing. This directly establishes a built-in global-reimbursement flow, but not the story's required payout in the employee's local currency. Missing for 10: explicit local-currency payout to the employee, supported payout countries and currencies, API or detailed lifecycle documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
